meta.name: Drum Island
meta.description: Cuando Nami cae enferma, la tripulación hace un desvío de Arabasta para buscar ayuda médica. Terminando en una isla de invierno habitada por una población desconfiada y una sola doctora con un misterioso reno de compañero.

videos.title: Tin Plate Wapol
videos.overview: En route to Arabasta, Nami falls ill. Without a doctor aboard the Going Merry, the Straw Hats must decide whether to stay the course or find more immediate help. As their ship crosses into a frigid area, a figure is seen standing on the water's surface.

videos.title: Adventure in a Nameless Country
videos.overview: If the Straw Hats have any chance of saving Nami, they must carry her up a mountain to see the sole doctor of a nameless, winter island. While Sanji and Luffy fight off the wilderness, a despicable king makes an unwanted return.

videos.title: The Summit
videos.overview: A devastating avalanche sweeps Drum Island and puts everyone at risk, but Luffy—step-by-step, hand-over-hand—continues his death-defying ascent up the mountain. Meanwhile, Vivi, Usopp, and Zoro reunite in the wake of the disaster.

videos.title: Enter: Tony Tony Chopper
videos.overview: Enter Chopper: a talking, transforming blue-nosed reindeer who was trained by Dr. Kureha in medicine. The Straw Hats immediately see the positives and want him on their crew, but Chopper must first deal with the monstrous pain in his heart.

videos.title: Inherited Will
videos.overview: Chopper began life as an ordinary reindeer but was shunned by his own kind because of his unusual blue nose. Even after eating the Human-Human Devil Fruit, the islanders wanted nothing to do with him. That is, until Chopper met a certain quack doctor.

videos.title: Unbreakable
videos.overview: Wapol and his comrades reach the mountaintop castle to wrest control of it back from Dr. Kureha and Chopper. Luffy, Sanji, and Chopper go head-to-head against his Munch-Munch powers, vowing to keep Wapol and his men from bringing down Hiriluk's flag.

videos.title: The Skies of Drum
videos.overview: Chopper counters the combined Chessmarimo with an item that expands his zoan fruit abilities. Wapol slips away into his old castle, but Luffy runs after him to force a final showdown.

videos.title: Hiriluk's Cherry Blossoms
videos.overview: Finally convinced to join the Straw Hat Pirates, Chopper announces his intentions to Dr. Kureha. While she doesn’t receive the news well at first, she decides to give the Straw Hats a fond parting gift while they exit the island.
